scope: Twenty acceptance milestones derived from the attached TRACE master prompt. Equal weights count deliverables, not workload. Optional/conditional actions are recorded separately. No percentage of textbook completion is inferred.

Extend existing bulk engine and preserve runtime records, IDs, progress, offline behavior and paused schedules.
Machine-readable canonical identities, hashes, independent stage states and validated ledger/report contract.
Materialize all twelve connected original PDFs, match hashes and visually verify imprints/contents before treating source access as established.
Source-page-verified exercise/question/subpart denominators across all 41 English/Tamil chapter pairs.
milestones.blocker: A full page-image inventory is not established. Repository links and text extraction cannot supply verified totals.

milestones.acceptance: Reopen and reconcile the latest five original W1–W5 ZIPs, not only historical summaries.
milestones.blocker: Original ZIPs are not in the checkout or connected Drive search; no ChatGPT Library file-access tool is available.

milestones.acceptance: Index dynamic runtime modules and pinned open-PR candidates; flag overlaps without silently merging distinct questions.
Operational source discrepancy/uncertainty checks covering editions, numerals/symbols, bilingual differences and figure-dependent items.
One reusable source-grounded deterministic family with separate reasoning representation and complete exam presentation.
Independent exact arithmetic, substitutions, domain/degeneracy checks and seeded counterexample/mutation tests for that family.
Qualified independent Tamil editorial review of complete bilingual content; never infer it from source access or generated text.

milestones.acceptance: Capability-based offline/dry-run routing interface with a clearly labelled mock and documented connection contract.
Tested missing-key/schema/timeout/429/5xx/replay/outage/cost/masking/interruption, bounded queues and spending ceilings.
Seeded 60-part stratified 30/30 allocator and failure-inclusive evaluator with conservative quality/adoption gates, using labelled fixtures when blocked.
Run the real 60 eligible unworked source-verified parts with independent math/bilingual/teacher review and real effort/cost measurements.
milestones.blocker: Sixty eligible unique unworked bilingual-source-checked parts plus reviewers have not been established. No real trial has started.

milestones.acceptance: Reproducible JSON/CSV gap reports and human delta with unknown denominators and unresolved mismatches.
Manual bounded commands and auditable resumption checkpoints; do not duplicate or resume automations.
Pass all applicable local and exact-head CI gates for the current implementation, with truthful source/teacher statuses.
milestones.blocker: PR148 passed all local and remote gates. The new compiler/pilot branch still needs its final full-suite and CI run.

milestones.acceptance: Integrate at least one complete eligible TRACE tooling slice after all gates, using exact-head merge protection and the existing lease.
Verify that tooling release's published commit/bytes plus live mobile, language, figure, navigation and offline behavior.
